entries.01bc977fbc2a1ee0: A company that, in three regions—Japan, China and Thailand—molds and processes plastic products such as power tool parts and automobile parts, and designs and manufactures molds for resin molding.
entries.0b535e0acf0a35e5: A company headquartered in Hekinan, Aichi Prefecture, with one consolidated subsidiary each in China and Thailand.
entries.0cc3ede09d20516b: Net income attributable to owners of the parent ¥47 million
entries.0d8afbf0f6ec6d49: Its main customers are in the power tool and automotive industries; in the fiscal year ended August 2025, power tool parts and automotive parts together accounted for 93.5% of revenue.
entries.13af89e32f63e887: Aiming to be a 'plastics maker loved by people,' the company has adopted as its corporate creed good ideas [pursuit of rationalization], good products [emphasis on reliability] and good workplaces [respect for humanity]; it will focus on research to create products that meet society's needs, raise its technological capabilities, establish an efficient production system, and seek to improve earnings power and strengthen its management base. Because sales depend on specific customers (the power tool and automotive industries), the company will devote effort to improving its own-brand anchor plugs and to research and development of new products, seeking to increase sales to customers beyond those specific customers. As part of its mission as a plastic products manufacturer, it also works to reduce and reuse discarded plastic, and is researching the development of building materials made from materials scheduled for disposal. At the research and development facility (plant factory) newly built in Hekinan, Aichi Prefecture in October 2024, it says it will continue research on growing vegetables and work on building mass-production equipment.

entries.2ca3fa2a6525c559: Based on the printing in the history section of its founding and the start of transactions with Makita Corporation, the printed business description stating that it handles both molding and mold design and manufacture, and the printed management policy, business environment and issues to address, which mention the operation of equipment that detects defects.
entries.2d12b82a330043f0: Revenue for the fiscal year ended August 2025 was ¥8,359 million, up only 0.2% from the previous year, and net income attributable to owners of the parent was ¥47 million, down 49.7% from the previous year. By region, revenue rose in Japan and Thailand, while in China revenue fell due to currency effects, even though orders for power tool parts increased. In Japan, increases in research and development costs for the plant factory newly built in October 2024 and in depreciation of newly acquired equipment weighed on results.

entries.6c76bf6124784569: A single business that molds plastic products and designs and manufactures molds for resin molding. The reportable segments, based on the production and sales structure by region, are three: "Japan," "China" and "Thailand," and in each region the company produces and sells power tool parts, automotive parts and other plastic products. Sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended August 2025 were ¥3,595 million in Japan, ¥3,851 million in China and ¥912 million in Thailand. Sales consisted of ¥7,981 million in product sales and ¥378 million in mold sales.

entries.b0f87f8aa3916ada: Since its founding in 1962, the company has been engaged in plastic injection molding, and it has built a track record of producing power tool molded parts, including continuing transactions with Makita Corporation since 1969. Its Anjo Plant has equipment for designing and manufacturing resin molds, and it handles molding and mold design and manufacture as one integrated operation. It has also introduced equipment that uses cameras to photograph products and detect defects, and is working to prevent defective products from leaving the company.
